{{Quote|Below them, against a background of stars, lay an icy white planet, like a '''Pearl''', whose surface was obscured by clouds and blowing snow.|Description of the planet Hoth|<ref name="Payback: The Tale of Dengar">{{StoryCite|story=Payback: The Tale of Dengar|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>}}
'''Pearl''' was a term used to describe the appearance of the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] from space.
